title: Property management
subtitle: Keep leases, maintenance, inspections, manual income and expenses, and recurring tasks together for each property.
scope_note: Owners see their properties, assigned realtors see the properties they manage, and admins have full access. Records stay inside your signed-in workspace.
search_placeholder: Search by property name or location
empty_property_search: No properties match that search. Try another name or location.
empty_properties: You do not have any properties assigned to this workspace yet.
select_property_hint: Select a property to start keeping its operational records.
period_filter_note: Dates apply to the statement and rent schedule. Record lists and current counts show all statuses and dates.
error_period: Choose valid start and end dates, in order, no more than 366 days apart.
record_counts_note: Current record counts across all dates and statuses. Select a category to add or edit records.
empty_records: No records here yet. Add a record to get started.
statement_range: {{start}} – {{end}} · Calculated as of {{asOf}} · Dominican Republic time
manual_note: These are manual operational records. This workspace does not collect payments, sign leases, reconcile bank accounts, or move money.
native_currency_note: Recorded entries only, in their original currency. USD and DOP are never combined.
deposit_statement_note: Refundable deposits stay outside operating income and expenses. Deposit movement covers this period; deposit balance includes recorded history through the statement end or today, whichever is earlier.
empty_currency: No recorded ledger history in this currency through the applicable date. No amount is estimated.
rent_schedule_note: Lease amounts due in the selected period. Received amounts come from recorded manual rent entries allocated to that lease and rent month; future receipts are excluded.
empty_rent_schedule: No lease rent is due in this period.
upcoming_tasks_note: Open items due within 30 days, including overdue items, calculated as of today.
empty_upcoming: No open tasks or inspections due in the next 30 days.
renewals_note: Active leases ending within 60 days, including end dates already passed. Review the lease before changing its status.
empty_renewals: No active leases needing renewal review.
recorded_entries_note: Recorded manual ledger entries within the selected dates. Planned and void entries are excluded.
empty_entries: No recorded ledger entries in this period.
private_record_note: This record is private to the property's authorized owner, assigned realtor, and admins.
save_before_action: Save or discard the form changes before taking this action.
uncertain_save: The server did not confirm the result. A save may have completed. To prevent duplicates or overwriting newer changes, reload this record or close and refresh the list before trying again.
confirm_discard: Discard your unsaved changes and close this record?
confirm_reload: Load the latest saved version? This replaces the form's unsaved changes.
confirm_approved: Record this owner's maintenance approval and its spending limit? No payment will be made.
confirm_declined: Record a declined maintenance approval? No payment will be made.
confirm_schedule: Create the next task from this completed recurring task? The server reuses an already-created occurrence for the same date.
approval_note: Approval records permission for maintenance work; it does not send instructions to the vendor or make a payment. Save the work order before approving it.
approval_not_required: Approval is not required for this work order.
approval_owner_only: Only the property owner or an admin can approve work or waive approval.
approval_controls_note: Assigned realtors cannot waive a required approval. Work marked approved, in progress, or completed needs current approval when required.
approval_reset_note: Changing the scope, title, category, vendor, currency, estimate, or approval requirement resets an existing approval. Costs above an approved limit also require a new review.
progress_note_hint: Use progress updates for routine work updates that keep the approved scope and budget unchanged.
next_scheduled: The next occurrence is scheduled. An existing occurrence for the same date is reused.
recurrence_note: Complete and save the current task, then choose Schedule next task. Monthly, quarterly, and yearly dates stay anchored to the original day and clamp to shorter months. Tasks are never scheduled automatically.
lease_note: Track the agreed tenancy here. This is an operational record, not an electronically signed contract. An active lease cannot overlap another active lease for the same unit.
whole_property_hint: Leave blank when the lease covers the entire property.
deposit_hint: Refundable deposits are tracked separately from operating income. Enter actual movements as manual ledger records.
due_day_hint: Monthly due day (1–31). Shorter months use their final day.
first_due_hint: Optional. If blank, the first rent date is the lease start date.
first_rent_hint: Optional first installment or prorated rent. If blank, the regular rent applies; zero is allowed.
reference_note: An optional HTTPS link to a document you already hold. No file is uploaded by this form.
maintenance_note: Estimates and actual work-order costs do not automatically create ledger expenses. Record an expense separately when appropriate.
inspection_complete_note: To complete an inspection, check all eight items and describe each issue.
evidence_hint: One existing HTTPS reference per line, up to 12. These are links only; no photos or files are uploaded.
transaction_date_hint: A recorded entry cannot be in the future. Use Planned for expected movements.
rent_period_hint: Rent month this receipt belongs to. If blank, the transaction month applies.
error_access: This workspace is available to the property's authorized owner, assigned realtor, or an admin. Please check your sign-in and property access.
error_missing: This property or record is no longer available to your account. Refresh the list.
error_conflict: This record changed since you opened it. Reload the latest version before saving.
error_overlap: An active lease already overlaps these dates for this unit. Review the existing lease or adjust the dates.
error_approval: This change needs current owner or admin approval. Save the work order for review first.
error_limit: Check the approval limit. It must be a valid non-negative amount and cover the proposed cost.
error_validation: Check the dates, amounts, property, and required fields. The server did not accept this change.
error_rate: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then refresh before trying again.
error_unavailable: Property records are temporarily unavailable. Refresh before retrying a save.

kind_notes.lease: Private tenancy terms, rent dates, refundable deposits, and existing document references.
kind_notes.maintenance: Work orders, vendor details, cost estimates, approval decisions, and completion status.
kind_notes.inspection: Eight practical checks, issue notes, and existing evidence links.
kind_notes.ledger: Manual financial movements only. Recorded entries affect the statement; planned or void entries do not.
kind_notes.task: Cleaning, maintenance, renewal, and administration tasks, with explicit recurring-task scheduling.

validation.title: Enter a title of 1–180 characters.
validation.status: Choose a valid status for this record.
validation.tenant: Enter a tenant name of 1–160 characters.
validation.email: Enter a valid email address or leave it blank.
validation.contact_length: Check the length of the name, phone, unit, or assignee fields.
validation.lease_dates: Use valid lease dates. An ended or terminated lease needs an end date on or after its start.
validation.first_due_date: The first rent due date must fall within the lease dates.
validation.due_day: Choose a whole due day from 1 to 31.
validation.money: Use valid amounts with up to two decimal places. Rent and ledger amounts must be greater than zero.
validation.url: Use a complete HTTPS link without a username or password.
validation.inspection_notes: Keep each inspection item note within 1,000 characters.
validation.inspection_complete: Complete all eight checks and describe every issue before completing the inspection.
validation.evidence_links: Use up to 12 complete HTTPS links, one per line, each at most 1,000 characters.
validation.rent_period: Choose a valid rent month and link a lease in the Rent category.
validation.category: Choose one of the available categories or options.
validation.transaction_date: Choose a valid transaction date. Future entries must remain Planned.

csv.manual_note: Manual operational records only; no payments collected or bank reconciliation. USD and DOP are separate. Refundable deposits are excluded from operating income.
csv.title: Title

approval_closed: This work order is closed. Its recorded approval and history remain available.
